name: Kerma Culture Burial (~2050-1750 BC)
description:
Scanned at the British Museum from behind a glass display case.

Plaque Reads:

"This reconstructed burial shows a typical Kerma culture grave from a cemetery in northern Sudan. The man has been placed in a crouched position on his right side, his head to the east, facing north. Sacrificed sheep/goats are by his feet, with pottery vessels and joints of meat to one side. Such ritual practices suggest that these people believed in some form of afterlife. Analysis of the skeleton showed that these are the remains of an adult male who was ~1.75m tall. He died between the ages of 35 & 50 & his teeth are heavily worn. This has led to dental disease and his upper jaw (maxilla) has a large abscess above one of the incisors. The healed fractures on his feet, ribs and long bones suggest an active or violent life. The fracture on his right ulna -called a parry fracture - usually occurs when the arm is lifted to deflect a blow to the head. The meat offerings from the sheep &/or goats, are all from young animals"

name: Red dragon ridge tile
description:
A splendidly detailed terracotta dragon roof ridge decoration from Truro, Cornwall, UK. On display in [Royal Cornwall Museum](https://www.royalcornwallmuseum.org.uk) (TRURI : 2004.44). This was originally on the roof of the appropriately named Red Dragon Hotel in the city.

Scanned through a glass case with @Polycam - retopologized with texture fixes in Blender.

name: Karnak bust at the Pettigrew Home & Museum
description:
This limestone(?) bust of an unknown female is in the rear annex of the Pettigrew Home & Museum.

It was purchased by Senator Pettigrew during a trip to Egypt. 

It is on the lowest shelf of a display case with highly reflective glass. Hence I could not get photos of the rear of the bust. The proper right side was obscured in shadows and reflections too.

name: Horror Props
description:
Props for horror-themed scene.
Low-poly, all-quad

PROPS
- Hutch: Antique wooden hutch with 3 shelves and 2 cabinet doors.
- Pots/Pans: Old cast iron pots and pans of different styles.
- Flashlight: Generic maglite style flashlight with rubber grip.
- Lantern/Mount: Old-style lantern that can be placed on a table or hung on the wall with the included wall mount.
- Chest: Small wooden lockbox with glowing symbols on it.
- Pedestal: Marble pedestal used for small busts.

EXTRA
- Bust: Decapitated Adobe Fuse character (for display purposes only).
